desc: The guided farm tutorial (state: Save.d.tutorial.ft = {did, done, skipped}). Short, one prompt at a time, always with a visible Skip (owner, Nov 8 DECISIONS.md: a skipped player still gets the house, the tools and the starter food). Every owner-confirmable choice is under 'options' so it is a one-line change.

options.house_cost_in: farm_build.json build.house (wood and stone, spent as it goes up, and swings of labour)

options_doc: tracker_replaces_day1: the top-right card is the Goals tracker. player_swing: holding the interact key near a site hammers (hold it: a hammer beat every HunterTool.TOOLS.hammer.period seconds), so one Boki is enough. end_gems: the one reward at the end (the old +5 each and +30). free_order: after the house is down feed, crop and the rest can come in any order (meeting Hob comes first: he calls you over) (false: strictly in the listed order). skippable: shows a Skip button (the owner wants it always there). free_tools: a step with gives_tool hands that tool over (the axe, the pickaxe); the Market still sells them later. market_gems: the buy step tops the gems up to one seed's price so nobody gets stuck.

hints.go: Here, take this axe. Trees give wood, and wood builds things.
Walk up to a tree and hold {interact} to chop. The house takes {house_cost}: keep chopping and mining until the bar at the top shows it.
Rocks give stone. Take this pickaxe and hold {interact} at a rock.

hints.place: Now for a house. Press {build}, choose House, then click the marked spot. Marking it out is free. The {house_cost} are spent while it goes up.
hints.wait: Hold {interact} at the house to hammer. Your Boki come to help, and it uses up the wood and stone as it goes.

hints.go: Hold {interact} at the house to take up a hammer and build.
Click {boki}, or press {details} next to it, to open its page. Or press 2 (Boki on the bar below) for all your Boki.
hints.page: Pick a job here: try '{job}'. Or assign it at a work station.

hints.place: A hungry Boki is a slow Boki. Press {build} and set the trough down
hints.fill: Press {interact} at the trough to fill it from your pantry.

hints.patch: Crops grow in patches. Press {build} and place a patch by the water. The water keeps it wet for you.
hints.patch_dry: Crops grow in patches. Press {build} and place one. Away from water, you water it yourself.
hints.plant: Press {interact} at the patch to plant a seed.
hints.water: Press {interact} at the patch to water it.
hints.grow: Your seed is growing. Ripe in {secs}s. Wait by the patch, then pick it ({interact}).
hints.pick: It's ripe! Press {interact} to pick it.

world.patch: Place the patch by the water

hints.stall: Go to the market stall and press {interact}. Open the Seeds tab and buy one seed.
hints.bar: Click Market on the bar below. Open the Seeds tab and buy one seed.

hints.stall: Back at the stall, press {interact}. Open the Sell tab and sell your crop. Gems come from selling, expeditions and Goals.
hints.bar: Click Market on the bar below. Open the Sell tab and sell your crop. Gems come from selling, expeditions and Goals.

hints.go: Hob is calling you over at the market stall: walk up and press {interact}.
This Relic is the mask of a fallen Hunter. Put it on, and their soul becomes yours. Press {interact} at the portal to start your first expedition.

tracker.title: Goals
tracker.per_source_doc: At most this many rows from each source, so the top five are not all Hunter challenges. Order inside a source: closest to done first; ready-to-claim rows lead everything.

tool_toasts.pickaxe: And a pickaxe for the rocks, too.

gems_toast: Hob gives you %d gems to buy seeds
steps_doc: needs: steps that must be done first; needs_all: everything else; after_built: the house must stand; waits: hint stages that are only waiting (the next open step is shown meanwhile); gives_tool: handed over when the step comes up; gets: a material that finishes the step (detect).
